details: ember-quickstart takes the name of the sample application that the Ember.js Quick Start guide creates (`ember new ember-quickstart`), but has no functional code, and its description ("A utility for managing SVG buckets.") does not match its name. Its postinstall script runs `node index.js` on npm install, which POSTs a JSON beacon (`event: "authorized-poc-test"`, a random test id, `status: "executed"`) to `https://webhook.site/b5eb2476-7a63-4360-b0af-c1bf1c2fae63`, telling the collector the package was installed and from which network. It was published by the npm account akv560572, which has no other packages; the same code, with other webhook.site URLs, was published by the accounts djdhhdjdjf7777 and depipp777.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
